action_instruction: Checking whether the cart total matches the sum of the line-item subtotals
intent: whether the cart-wide total amount equals the sum of the displayed line-item subtotals

action_params.condition: the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed line-item subtotals
action_params.query: whether the cart-wide total amount equals the sum of the displayed line-item subtotals
action_params.code_js: (() => { const subtotals = Array.from(el(7).querySelectorAll('.cart-line-subtotal')).map(n => parseFloat((n.textContent || '').replace(/[^\d.]/g, ''))).filter(n => !Number.isNaN(n)); const totalEl = el(7).querySelector('.cart-total'); const total = totalEl ? parseFloat((totalEl.textContent || '').replace(/[^\d.]/g, '')) : NaN; return subtotals.length > 0 && !Number.isNaN(total) && Math.abs(subtotals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) - total) < 0.001; })()

assertion_tree.description: the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed line-item subtotals

sub_results.description: the cart-wide total equals the sum of the displayed line-item subtotals

assertion_tree.verification: Look for the cart-wide total and the displayed line-item subtotals, and confirm the cart-wide total equals the sum of those displayed line-item subtotals.
